workflow.name: Regel #1: Gebruiksfunctie komt overeen met bestemming

step.name: Insert Areas
step.description: Build the areas dataset by finding which geographic service areas contain the building, based on its location in the IFC model.

step.name: Insert BBoxes
step.description: Calculate and store the 3D bounding box for every geometry that doesn't have one yet.

step.name: Insert Projections
step.description: Generate and store a 2D map projection for every 3D geometry that doesn't have one yet.

step.name: Insert Topological Relations
step.description: Determine and update whether each wall in the building model spatially overlaps with residential ("wonen") planning zones.

step.name: Validate Topological Relations
step.description: Validate that every geometry in the model is fully contained within a designated planning zone — and flag any that are not.

step.name: Validate BBoxes
step.description: Validate that every geometry has a realistic physical size — not too small and not too large — in all three dimensions.

step.name: Validate Model BBox
step.description: Validate that the combined physical footprint of the entire building dataset as a whole has a realistic size — not too small and not too large — in all three dimensions.
